concepts.title: Banjo Orientation
concepts.summary: Identify the head, bridge, neck, and the short fifth string, and settle into a stable seated position.

concepts.title: Open G Tuning
concepts.summary: Tune the five strings to open G and check the fifth string against the fretted fifth.

concepts.title: Forward Roll
concepts.summary: Play a repeating thumb-index-middle roll evenly across three strings.
Perform a short tune by combining a roll pattern, fretted notes, and a steady pulse.

edges.rationale: String identity depends on knowing the instrument layout.
A stable position precedes keeping time on the instrument.
Strumming an open chord requires the open tuning to be correct.
A strum pattern is a pulse expressed by the strumming arm.
Rolls replace the strum once the picking hand is reliable.
Holding a chosen tempo presupposes holding a pulse at all.
The tune is played with the roll pattern.
A performed tune has to hold its tempo.
